authority: PI, 2026-09-02, assigning the two open namespace fields CCP_S2_SPEC.json (bf41980a) deliberately left unfilled
rule: this is an APPEND, not an edit. CCP_S2_SPEC.json is not modified in place; this record supplies the two fields it left open and nothing else. Any conflict between this record and the frozen spec is resolved by re-freezing, never by silent edit of either file.

collection_state_source.purpose: generates the incumbent's own deployment trajectories from which the frozen stratified selector (CCP_S2_SPEC.json#COLLECTION_DISTRIBUTION) chooses the 64 Pole-A and 64 Pole-B boundaries
collection_state_source.scale_precedent: mirrors the previous 320-seed collection scale used elsewhere in this program
collection_state_source.hard_bound: the selector may draw candidates ONLY from this block. If a frozen stratum cannot be filled from within it, the run STOPS with a selection shortfall and is recorded as such -- seeds are never quietly added to fill a stratum.

eval_block.purpose: S2 sealed payoff EVAL, per CCP_S2_SPEC.json#EVAL_PROTOCOL
eval_block.sharing_rule: the SAME 64 seeds score TREATMENT and CONTROL, and both z0/z1 cells on each pole -- required for both the within-policy crossover bootstrap and the treatment-control Gamma bootstrap to be properly paired

intentional_gap.purpose: deliberately unused, a visual and mechanical separation between the collection namespace and the sealed EVAL namespace -- makes an accidental off-by-one or copy-paste overlap immediately implausible rather than merely improbable

measurement.domain_separated_from: the sealed predecessor's 'CCP_PHASE1' mapping and from the bank-construction mapping below -- distinct string literals guarantee no collision even if state_id/estimand/j values coincide
measurement.pairing_rule: BASE, pi_A, and pi_B all receive the IDENTICAL r_j for a given (state_id, estimand, j) -- three-arm CRN, not pairwise. This is the direct three-arm generalisation of the predecessor's two-arm r(s,e,m,pi_A,j) == r(s,e,m,pi_B,j) invariant.

bank_construction.domain_separated_from_measurement: distinct namespace string ('S2_BANK' vs 'CCP_S2_MEASURE') and distinct arity (no j) -- the canonical rollout cannot coincide with any of the 16 measurement continuations even by construction, not merely by low collision probability.

REQUIRED_MECHANICAL_PREFLIGHT_BEFORE_ANY.rule: all seven checks below run as ONE report. Any failure blocks all subsequent CCP-S2 work, including the state selector.
checks: no previously frozen artifact in this project contains 11700001..11700320 or 11701001..11701064 as an experimental seed allocation
the collection block and the EVAL block are disjoint from each other
the collection selector's implementation is hard-bounded to 11700001..11700320 -- cannot construct a candidate state outside that range
the EVAL manifest, once built, contains exactly 64 unique seeds, no duplicates, no seeds outside 11701001..11701064
no collection or training code path can import or reference the EVAL manifest module/file
BASE, pi_A and pi_B receive IDENTICAL CCP_S2_MEASURE continuation seeds for every (state_id, estimand, j) triple
the bank-construction seed namespace (S2_BANK) is lexically and functionally distinct from the measurement namespace (CCP_S2_MEASURE)
REQUIRED_MECHANICAL_PREFLIGHT_BEFORE_ANY.sequence: seed preflight PASS -> build state selector -> build 3-arm collector -> no causal measurement begins before both.
